text:
Priya (AE): Hey team — CassioCare POC needs teraText-14B-ft variant onboarded this week. They want to start on Hosted API for the demo and then move to Dedicated for production. Main asks: p95 latency target ~200ms, prefix/KV cache for chat, int4 quantized variant available, KMS for PHI, and a hosted pricing estimate for ~100M generated tokens/month. Can infra run a quick compatibility sweep? cc @Theo

Theo (Infra): On it. Do we have the model artifact format? HF tar.gz, safetensors, ggml? Also need info about any custom layers or LoRA adapters.

Priya (AE): They uploaded an HF tar.gz with a small LoRA adapter. Model config shows custom RMSNorm (norm_type: "rmsnorm") and kv_cache enabled. Link to dealbook: https://redwood.internal/deals/cassiocare/packet (see attachments).

Gus (Solutions): FYI RMSNorm + KV cache means we have to confirm fused kernel support in the runtime. I can run a smoke test on qsm-rt-3 today. Also ask product: what's our recommended quant profile for teraText-style weights?

Kelsey (Sales Eng): For the pricing ask — I'll draft a ballpark for hosted vs dedicated. For 100M tokens/month (mostly generation), rough hosted cost estimate is in the $1k-$3k/mo range depending on token mix and caching. Dedicated gets you predictable throughput and lower unit cost but requires a commit. I'll firm numbers after infra test.

Lina (Security): Heads-up — CassioCare will require KMS integration and an executed DPA before PHI flows. They also uploaded a security questionnaire. Can someone drop the questionnaire PDF into the dealbook and ping me when posted? I'll triage controls (KMS, audit logs, network egress).

Theo (Infra): deploy-bot kicked off a variant-compat scan. Config I used:
```
model: teraText-14B-ft
format: hf-tar.gz
variants: [fp32, int8, int4]
check_kv_cache: true
check_rmsnorm_kernels: true
```

deploy-bot: compatibility-scan started for 6123456789 (teraText-14B-ft)

deploy-bot: compatibility-scan complete — summary:
- KV cache: SUPPORTED (prefix caching validated)
- RMSNorm: FALLBACK (no fused RMSNorm kernel on default runtime; will run slower unless patched)
- int4 quant: SUCCESS (int4 path works but requires quantization config A1 and a tiny kernel patch for attention scaling)
- LoRA: detected separate adapter files — recommend merging adapters for inference to avoid extra runtime overhead

Gus (Solutions): I ran throughput tests on qsm-rt-3 after applying the int4 profile and merging the LoRA. With batch_size=8 and micro-batching turned on, observed p95 ~= 180ms for 1k-token context in steady-state. Cold-start was >500ms (no warm KV). Recommendation: enable prefix KV cache warmup and set autoscale min=1 for POC to avoid cold starts. Also need the RMSNorm patch — infra can hotfix for the POC.

Theo (Infra): I can apply the kernel patch to the dev runtime and roll a canary. That should restore fused RMSNorm performance. For Dedicated/production we'll bake it in. Also confirming KMS flow: CassioCare uses Azure KeyVault — we have an integration path (requires customer-managed key with service principal). Lina, I'll surface the steps.

Lina (Security): Good. For the KMS path we'll need: (1) KMIP/KMS connection doc for CassioCare, (2) audit-log retention plan, (3) brief on where plaintext keys are never stored. I'll draft answers to the questionnaire items after you drop the wiring docs.

Kelsey (Sales Eng): Next steps from my side: (1) capture infra test results + p95 numbers, (2) produce hosted vs dedicated price sheet, (3) propose a POC plan: 2-week hosted trial with 200k token cap + optional Dedicated demo with reserved slot for load test. I'll send a one-pager to Priya and legal.

Priya (AE): Awesome — timeline request from customer: demo Friday (5 days). Can we have the dev runtime patch applied and a Hosted trial slot by Thursday EOD?

Theo (Infra): I'll prioritize the RMSNorm kernel patch on dev and roll canary by Wednesday. deploy-bot will post status.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: dev-runtime-rmsnorm-patch -> start 6123456798

deploy-bot: canary deploy complete. Kernel patch active on canary nodes.

Gus (Solutions): Re-ran the micro-bench after canary patch: cold-start improved to ~320ms, steady p95 unchanged (~175-185ms). With prefix cache warmup we hit <200ms p95 reliably. :thumbsup:

Lina (Security): Questionnaire uploaded at https://redwood.internal/deals/cassiocare/secq.pdf — I'm filling answers now; I'll flag any blockers.

Kelsey (Sales Eng): I uploaded a draft price sheet to the dealbook and DM'd finance for the exact hosted unit numbers. Priya — I'll share before EOD today.

Priya (AE): Thanks everyone. If infra + security are green by Thursday, I'll confirm the Friday demo. Please ping in this thread when the hosted trial is provisioned.

Gus (Solutions): Noted. I'll also add a short README for the adapter-merge step and recommended quant config (A1) into the repo so SRE/Eng can reproduce.

deploy-bot: hosted-trial provisioned (trial-id: ct-612345). Endpoint and keys uploaded to dealbook.

Priya (AE): Received keys, sharing with CassioCare tonight. Demo scheduled Friday 10am PST. Thanks team! :party-parrot:
